text: This solution, Four-Party Accountability System for Underground Flooding Zones addresses natural catastrophe in Republic of Korea (South Korea) between Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS), Ministry of Environment (MOE), Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT), and Seoul Metropolitan Government (SMG). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
